transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I suppose what brings me in is... I've been having this issue late at night. Once I start picking at the leftovers in the fridge, it feels like the sensible part of me is sitting there saying, "That’s enough, Alejandro," but my hand just keeps going back for more anyway. I just can't seem to stop myself once I get started.
After these episodes of eating, do you do anything to try to make up for the food you've eaten, such as making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do anything like that. I mean, I definitely don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything. And I'm certainly not out there exercising excessively at my age. I mostly just... well, I just go to bed feeling uncomfortably full and upset with myself. But no, I don't try to get rid of the food.
About how many times a week do these late-night eating episodes usually happen?
Well, looking back on it... I'd say they happen at least once most weeks. Often it's two nights a week. It's been going on like that since my cousin moved in with me.
How long ago did your cousin move in with you?
It's been about four months now. Yeah, my older cousin came to live with us then, and that's pretty much when this whole thing started.
